Self-mastery hi real power hai.
Vishwas karo ki aap kar sakte hain, aur aap aadhi doori tay kar chuke hain.
Attitude decide karta hai altitude.
Hazaar mil ka safar ek kadam se shuru hota hai.
Sahi disha mein chhote steps sabse bade ban sakte hain.
Sky target karo, par step-by-step chalo.
Mindset, talent se zyada matter karta hai.
Body wahi achieve karti hai jo mind believe kare.
"Tumhara mind sab kuch hai. Jaisa sochoge, waisa banoge."
Agar succeed karna hai, fail hona padega.
